title: Fourier One-Norm
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube $\\{−1,1\\}^n$, its Fourier one-norm is the sum, over all subsets $S$ of the $n$ coordinates, of the absolute values of its Fourier coefficients: $\\sum_{S\\subseteq[n]} |\\widehat f(S)|$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
